reviews.review_msg: Stephen Is definitely one of my favourite profs that I have taken in my post secondary education. He is very knowledgeable about the content and is passionate about it. He is a super friendly guy and makes the classes as fun as an English class can be. I definitely recommend him.

Loved his class on climate fiction. He did make us do a group project but it honestly wasn't too bad and we had lots of time. The books were super interesting and he's a great, caring, interesting prof. A few super short quizzes and the final exam was mostly paragraphs about the books
Amazing lecturer. He truly cares about what he is teaching and he also cares about your time as a student. As long as you read the books and go to class you will do great.

I really enjoyed this class with him. Instructions were clear and quizzes and exams were pretty easy. He always looked for feedback on the class to try and improve it for next time. I highly suggest taking him and also ENGL 397 too!

Really understanding guy, who explains topics well. He's so approachable with questions and I would 10/10 recommend going to his office hours. We had 2 quizzes which you really just had to study the slides to do well on them. The finals also aren't long at all, it's just 3-5 short paragraph questions that you can complete within 40 minutes.
